identity.title: [v0.92.1][AWS][runtime-v3] Cut warm Polis GPU startup with prebuilt artifacts and persistent EBS

values.summary: The final source-bound warm two-node AWS Polis qualification passed in 240 seconds apply-to-service-ready for the current two-8B-model configuration. Runtime local readiness was 5.950 seconds and GPU local readiness was 97.340 seconds. Both models remained resident, all six Runtime agents executed governed ACC tools, Guardian and degradation recovery passed, all disposable resources were removed, and both warm EBS volumes remain detached and available. The operator extended the issue ceiling to USD 21 before completion; the conservative issue total is USD 20.025563 with USD 0.974437 remaining.
actual_changes: Compressed the complete Runtime user-data payload and enforced EC2's 16 KiB rendered payload limit in Terraform tests.
Kept full-create topology strict while allowing correctly typed partial destroy after interrupted applies.
Removed brittle floating-point equality and aligned cost tests with the production tolerance.
Aligned controller, guest failsafe, documentation, Terraform, and audit ceilings with the operator-authorized USD 21 limit.
Captured durable source-bound timing, model residency, ACC, Guardian recovery, cost, retained-volume, and zero-residue evidence.

actual_validation.purpose: Prove payload, cleanup, authorization, cost, residue, and recovery contracts locally.
Prove the rendered warm Runtime payload and Terraform topology.
Prove the source-bound current two-8B-model warm Polis on real AWS GPU infrastructure.
Prove no disposable issue-owned AWS resources remain.
